about_the_game:
Chaturanga is a chess inspired roguelike centered around evolving your pieces and defeating random famous chess variants.

Spanning 5 stages with 3 levels in each stage and a progressively more sophisticated and well equipped AI, every playthrough becomes a unique variant. With 30 piece types, 50 mods and over 20 chess variants you will have to find different ways to win each time. Purchase single use and persistent mods to further modify the rules of chess and tilt the odds in your favor.
detailed_description:
Chaturanga is a chess inspired roguelike centered around evolving your pieces and defeating random famous chess variants.

Spanning 5 stages with 3 levels in each stage and a progressively more sophisticated and well equipped AI, every playthrough becomes a unique variant. With 30 piece types, 50 mods and over 20 chess variants you will have to find different ways to win each time. Purchase single use and persistent mods to further modify the rules of chess and tilt the odds in your favor.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Both Apple Silicon and Intel. Intel Core i3 (e.g., 4th gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (or older equivalent like FX series)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (e.g., 6th gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 (1st gen or newer) / Apple Silicon M1 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern integrated graphics (Intel Iris Xe, recent AMD Radeon integrated, Apple Silicon GPU)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: The ultimate chess variant roguelike game.  Start with pieces and the board set up for the ancient precursor to chess, Chaturanga. Defeat progressively more sophisticated computer opponents and chess variants while leveling up your pieces to their modern equivalents and beyond into new faery pieces.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
